clips.send: Choose a set of clues. Drag C′ or use the slider to make every clue fit. Can you find a second fit on the same side of the base? AB is the side between the two angles. Move C′ along the ray from A′ until the angle at B′ also matches. Congruent figures have the same shape and size. Translations, rotations and reflections preserve lengths and angles. Triangles can face different ways and still be congruent if these motions make them coincide.

clips.send: OP splits the 60° angle into two 30° angles. The distances to the sides are the lengths of the perpendicular segments PD and PE. A point on an angle bisector is equally far from both sides of the angle.

clips.send: Keep AB and ∠A fixed. To build a triangle with the given opposite side length BC, look where the ray from A meets the circle centered at B. At BC equals 5 cm the ray meets the circle twice, giving two different lengths for AC. Both triangles satisfy the same SSA clues, yet they are different shapes. SSA is therefore not a general congruence criterion.

clips.send: 让顶点 A 始终在中点 M 的正上方，改变三角形的高。底边上的高、底边上的中线和顶角平分线重合，都是 AM，这就是“三线合一”。试试等边情形。 AB等于AC，所以两个底角 ∠B 与 ∠C 相等。

clips.send: 选一组已知条件，拖动 C′ 或移动滑块，让试拼三角形满足全部条件。试试在底边的同一侧能否再找到一个满足条件的位置。 AB 是两角的夹边。沿 A′ 发出的射线移动 C′，使 ∠B′ 也符合已知条件。 全等图形的形状和大小都相同。平移、旋转和轴对称都保持长度与角度。即使两个三角形的朝向不同，只要能用这些变换完全重合，它们就全等。

clips.send: 固定 AB 和 ∠A。要让 ∠A 的对边 BC 达到指定长度，就找从 A 出发的射线与以 B 为圆心的圆的交点。 当 BC等于5 厘米时，射线与圆相交于两点，AC 的长度有两个不同的值。这两个三角形满足同样的 SSA 条件，却不全等。因此 SSA 不能作为一般的全等判定。
